# Foodedo

> Foodedo helps people decide what to cook for dinner, plan their week, save recipes and shop from a list linked to their saved meal plan.

The public website is https://www.foodedo.com. Its main sections are the recipe catalogue, meal-planning and shopping-list guides, the blog, and help and support.

Guests can browse public recipes and try a temporary dinner plan on their device. An account is required to keep plans, save personal recipes and share a household. Saving a plan creates its linked shopping list. Household members share a plan and shopping list while retaining a separate Private planning space.

Shopping lists combine compatible ingredient lines; different names or units may remain separate. Foodedo does not automatically track pantry stock. The FAQ and help pages provide current feature and access details.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.foodedo.com/): Product overview and entry point for trying a suggested dinner plan.
- [Recipes](https://www.foodedo.com/recipes): Browse the public Foodedo recipe catalogue and follow links to individual recipes.
- [How to use Foodedo](https://www.foodedo.com/support/how-to-use): Getting started with planning, saving a plan, shopping and importing recipes.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.foodedo.com/faq): Current information about free access, guest planning, accounts, recipes and households.

## Meal planning and shopping guides

- [Meal planner with a grocery list](https://www.foodedo.com/meal-planner-with-grocery-list): How suggested dinners connect to a shopping list when a plan is saved.
- [Recipe to shopping list](https://www.foodedo.com/recipe-to-shopping-list): Worked example combining three dinners for two into a shopping list, including quantities and checks.
- [How to make a shopping list from recipes](https://www.foodedo.com/how-to-make-a-shopping-list-from-recipes): Step-by-step instructions for choosing dinners, saving a plan, checking cupboards and shopping.
- [How to create a weekly meal plan quickly](https://www.foodedo.com/how-to-create-a-weekly-meal-plan-fast): Start with suggested dinners and review the week.
- [Meal planning for busy weeknights](https://www.foodedo.com/meal-planning-for-busy-weeknights): Plan dinners around available time and effort.
- [Family meal planning](https://www.foodedo.com/family-meal-planning): Suggested dinners, flexible servings and shopping for a family.
- [Household meal planning](https://www.foodedo.com/household-meal-planning): Shared planning and shopping, invitations and separate Private and Household spaces.

## More content and support

- [Blog](https://www.foodedo.com/blog): Articles and guides about meal planning, cooking and shopping.
- [Help and support](https://www.foodedo.com/support): Help with plans, shopping lists and household sharing.
- [Contact](https://www.foodedo.com/support/contact): Contact the Foodedo team with a question, problem or idea.
- [Sitemap](https://www.foodedo.com/sitemap.xml): Index of public pages, published recipes and blog articles.
